scope: Read-only actual image and saved control coordinate audit. No new geometry, render or repair.

Actual local displacement decomposition shows the original/replay mask-splice gradient strongly magnifies deformation in this region. Current fine texture does not repair the inherited major termination.

matched_images.observation: Original WIDE retains rounded cups/returns in the central lower band; REVISED introduces straighter flat plate endings.

sources_loaded.binding_scope: Actual arrays loaded; prior exact association/file bindings retained in PREPARATION.json and end_rule receipt. Full large-file hashes were not repeated in this audit.

operator.mask_origin: Previous marked-band volume-junction mask: quintic(coarse_mask/.30), then actual V/E/F scalar lifts. Reused for the larger early-rule replay difference.
operator.old_WIDE_support: max(0,1-((abs(wrapped_phase)-1.55)/1.20)^2)^3; old WIDE already includes it without the same new flat endings. It is not supported as the primary new cause.

measurement.projection_scope: Saved controls projected into the inherited camera; rounded-pixel minimum control depth is an approximate front-surface filter, not exact rendered triangle-ID picking.
measurement.exact_decomposition: For D=Xfull_replay-Xoriginal: m_a*D_a-m_b*D_b=((m_a+m_b)/2)*(D_a-D_b)+(m_a-m_b)*((D_a+D_b)/2). Terms are replay-displacement gradient and mask gradient respectively.

interpretation: A continuous mask does not ensure a gentle geometric blend when a large replay difference changes across a short physical edge. Its gradient is a measured dominant contributor on representative affected edges. The visual cut is not proof of an open mesh boundary.
limits: Full replay also changes local morphology. No full-replay matched render, exclusive sole-cause claim or completed repair. Exact visible ownership of every overlapping sheet remains unresolved.
next_direction_not_executed: Separate major termination repair from fine texture: broaden/redesign the local original-replay blend to limit displacement gradients, or locally restore the original rounded end before reusing the continuous fine field. Avoid global smoothing or covering the termination with more ornament.
